subject: Private deployment: account setup & network readiness for Greenline POC
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenline.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline POC: account/project setup + network constraints

Hi team,

Thanks for the demo last week — Greenline is ready to move to a short POC (3 weeks) for private deployment in our US data center. Before we schedule the on-site/network kickoff, sharing a compact list of our constraints. Can Redwood confirm which of these are blockers vs. typical configuration items?

- On-prem racks run Palo Alto FWs; egress must go through corporate web proxy (proxy.greenline.internal:8080).
- No inbound SSH from public internet; we allow jump host only via internal bastion (10.10.5.0/24).
- All TLS certs must be issued by our internal private CA; external certs require approval process (2–3 business days).
- We use AWS S3-compatible object store in our VPC with VPC endpoint (no public S3).
- KMS provided via an on-prem HSM (nCipher) — interface via PKCS#11.
- MTU on our network is 9000; please confirm Redwood agent/container networking and jumbo frames support.

Attached is a short config note from our infra team (Greenline-PS-MA-ConfigNotes.txt). Looking to schedule a 40-minute sync next week.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Eng, Greenline Health

Attachments: Greenline-PS-MA-ConfigNotes.txt
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenline.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline POC: account/project setup + network constraints

Alex / Priya — thanks for the details and the note. Welcome aboard.

Summary of immediate asks from Redwood to validate readiness before we stand up the private deployment:
1) Account & project: return the AWS account IDs (or VPC peering CIDRs) you want Redwood to use for the POC. We will provision a project-scoped control plane endpoint and dedicated subnet mapping.
2) Firewall/NAT: confirm outbound proxy credentials and whether TLS inspection is enabled; list of outbound domains we need to allow (redwood-inference.example.net, storage endpoints).
3) Certificates & KMS: we can integrate with PKCS#11-backed HSMs; please confirm if you want us to use our managed certs (short-term for POC) or your private CA.
4) MTU & performance: we support jumbo frames in the runtime but need to validate host kernel and container network (we’ll run a validation job).
5) Access model: we never require public SSH to service nodes; we prefer using our agent over mutual TLS — but if you mandate bastion-only, we can adapt.

Attached: Redwood_VPC_Template.yaml (sample CIDR ranges + route tables) and a short validation runbook. Propose a network kickoff call Wednesday 26 Aug 11:00–11:40 PT — does that work?

Next steps: can Priya share the account/VPC details and egress proxy contact? Dev, can you propose the validation test plan after we get those details?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Template.yaml, Network-Validation-Runbook.pdf
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenline.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline POC: account/project setup + network constraints

Vanessa — thanks, Wednesday doesn't work for some of our infra folks. Proposal: Monday 30 Aug 09:00 PT. Below are the details you requested from our side:

- VPCs/CIDRs: app-prod-vpc: 10.240.0.0/16 (we will carve a /22 for the POC); control-plane-vpc: 10.241.0.0/24
- Proxy: proxy.greenline.internal:8080 (basic auth). TLS inspection: enabled for outbound to public internet.
- Bastion jump: 10.10.5.10 (SSH only from our corp VPN). No public SSH allowed to nodes.
- Storage: internal S3 endpoint at s3.internal.greenline:443 (DNS in our zone only).
- HSM: yes, nCipher HSM; network access via 10.241.0.50:1500 (we will open only from control-plane hosts).
- MTU: 9000 on the rack; please confirm container overlay will honor host MTU.

We are OK with Redwood using managed certs for the POC to reduce timeline, but production must use our private CA.

Attached the quick config notes from our network team. Reach out to infra@greenline.internal if you need firewall ticket contact.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
Senior Infrastructure Manager, Greenline Health

Attachment: Greenline-PS-MA-ConfigNotes.txt
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenline.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline POC: account/project setup + network constraints

Thanks for the details, Priya. Below is the validation & acceptance plan I propose for the POC network kickoff on Mon 30 Aug 09:00 PT (owners and pass/fail criteria). I put rough times in parentheses for the kickoff agenda.

1) Account/policy mapping (15m) — Owner: marissa_cole
   - Confirm VPC allocation: Greenwood to provide the /22 to use. PASS: Redwood control-plane endpoint reachable via the expected control CIDR; mutual TLS handshake completes.

2) Firewall/proxy egress (10m) — Owner: vanessa_ortiz
   - Validate outbound to our service domains through proxy.greenline.internal:8080. PASS: HTTPS POST to token endpoints and artifact fetches succeed (200/204) with proxy auth.

3) HSM/KMS handshake (10m) — Owner: dev_patel
   - Validate PKCS#11 session established from Redwood keymanager container to 10.241.0.50:1500. PASS: key listing and sign/verify cycle completes within 2s.

4) MTU & throughput test (15m) — Owner: hannah_schmitt
   - Run iperf between pod and internal node with MTU 9000. PASS: no fragmentation, throughput within 85% of baseline.

5) Storage & DNS (10m) — Owner: laura_bennett
   - Resolve s3.internal.greenline and validate PUT/GET to internal S3 endpoint via VPC endpoint. PASS: object round-trip <500ms for small object, auth validated.

6) TLS/cert policy (5m) — Owner: vanessa_ortiz
   - Confirm POC usage of Redwood-managed certs and note production CA requirement. PASS: HTTPS endpoints present valid Redwood cert chain.

7) Operational access & RBAC (10m) — Owner: marissa_cole
   - Confirm bastion-only model and agent-based deployment for node management. PASS: no public 22 accessible; access via bastion documented.

Deliverables after the call (to be provided within 48 hours):
- Completed Network-Validation-Runbook.pdf notes populated with test outputs (owner: hannah_schmitt).
- Ticket template for firewall/NAT exceptions (owner: vanessa_ortiz).
- Temporary cert expiry schedule if using Redwood-managed certs (owner: laura_bennett).

If all PASS, we'll move to provisioning the POC environment and schedule the install window (provisioning estimated 4–6 hours). If any FAIL, we will enumerate fixes and target a re-test.

Can Priya confirm the availability for the 30 Aug 09:00 PT slot and who will be on the infra side to run the iperf/MTU test?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.example.com | +1 415-555-0123
